newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica June inflation rises 0.78 percent.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica June inflation rises 0.78 percent.

text.p: Costa Rica posted an increase in its inflation rate of 0.78 percent in June, slightly higher than the 0.51 percent registered in May, the government said on Tuesday.
The Ministry of Trade, Economy and Industry said the acculumated inflation rate from January to June this year was 6.58 percent, compared to 6.83 percent in the same time frame a year earlier.
Among leading factors in this June's hike were increases in food products and for dentist visits.
